sections.title: Quick Inferences
sections.passage:
"He hardly ever brushes his teeth."

"Mandy lay in the bath until the water was cold."

"Ralph was usually a quiet dog."

Read each sentence and answer the question.

responses.prompt: Does he clean his teeth often? How do you know that?
responses.response: no because it says he hardly does it

responses.prompt: Was Mandy in the bath for a long time? How do you know that?
responses.response: because it says until meaning he/she was waiting

responses.prompt: Did Ralph bark often? How do you know that?
responses.response: no because he is usually a quiet dog

sections.title: The Car
sections.passage:
The sun was just below the distant hills when the car's engine suddenly stopped.

"Why didn't I stop and fill up?" Mum asked.'

She banged her hands on the steering wheel. We both went very quiet.

We got out and pushed the car to the side of the road. Then we looked around. There was nothing but flat, empty land stretching towards the hills. We looked hopefully along the straight road. There wasn't another car in sight. A cold wind was blowing. We were soon back in the car. We could only wait and hope.

When it was dark Mum must have thought I was worried. She suggested a game of I Spy. It wasn't easy to play, so we sang some of our favourite songs.

At last we saw two headlights. We couldn't believe our eyes when we saw what kind of vehicle it was.

The driver winched our car up so that the front wheels were off the ground. We climbed into the cab of the truck and headed for the next town.

responses.prompt: Was Mum upset when the car's engine stopped? How do you know that?
responses.response: she was upset because she banged her head on the steering wheel

responses.prompt: Why did the car's engine stop?
Why did they get back into the car?
responses.response: because it was getting dark there was a cold wind

responses.prompt: Why wasn't it easy to play 'I Spy'?
What sort of vehicle stopped to help them?

questionScores.rationale: Correctly answers no, with evidence from 'hardly'.
Shows understanding that 'until' implies a wait/duration, consistent with a long bath.
Reasonable inference of a pirate costume item from the dialogue.
Reasonable inference of a wishing/Christmas-style tree from the passage.
Correctly infers Mum was upset, citing the steering wheel action (minor detail slip on 'head' vs 'hands').
Correctly infers running out of fuel from 'didn't stop and fill up'.
Correctly cites cold and darkness as reasons to get back in the car.
Correctly infers nothing to see made the game hard.
Correctly identifies a truck matching the tow-truck description.
